<thought>We need the template that, when applied retrosynthetically to the target molecule, yields the precursors [['CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1', 'O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2']]. This template should correspond to an electrophilic aromatic bromination (formation of a C‑Br bond, i.e., a halide functional group). We'll search the template catalog for templates that form a halide in the forward direction and retrieve their IDs and mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["halide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
